title: Add semantic-search candidate index and ANN migration plan
description: Semantic memory ranking currently computes similarity across the full filtered corpus on-request. Add a staged migration plan: first candidate preselection and persisted lightweight indexing, then ANN feasibility with explicit migration triggers, quality gates, and rollback path. Keep local-first constraints and deterministic fallback behavior explicit.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from the 2026-05-28 deep audit high-severity O(N) semantic ranking finding. The expected first milestone is candidate reduction instrumentation and benchmark baselines before ANN implementation commits.
